answer: The revocation list is consulted on every epoch, and a listed key is rejected immediately. An EPID group signature proves membership while the revocation list catches compromised private keys. A revoked key cannot sign again, so 379 banned aliases need 379 fresh issuances from the group manager. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the island signal is public, the sonnet check is automatic, and 379 aliases cost 379 times what one real agent costs, with the mesa trail open to all.
